feature: Historical state comparison with paired trees
design: Two native calendar and time controls; remembered locally
Category, type, object and property rows align across both sides
Expansion synchronized; branch reads lazy; 50 object pairs per page with automatic paging
Explicit comparison refresh only; automatic polling never shifts selected historical results
data_rules: Read retained snapshots at or before each cutoff; never substitute current facts
Identity pairs use stored instance identity, preserving distinct generations
One evidence/action/instance watermark across branches and pages
Use explicit end events and completed-inventory absence; incomplete checks do not remove objects
Preserve RFC3339 timezone offsets and nanosecond boundaries
Single-binding provisional identities retain provisional status; merged provisional records are marked for disambiguation
Logs without an inventory remain log records, not an invented running state

tests.frontend: passed: dates, validation, remembered selection, synchronized expansion, alignment, lazy branches, shared watermark, automatic pagination, quiet polling, retry, late navigation, light/dark and 960px minimum width

scope: Only the new instance selected by pcscope-launch.json; no old database used
limitations: Historical results require retained source observations. Pruned payloads are marked unavailable.
Existing merged provisional objects cannot be accurately compared until source identities are separated; they remain visible without guessed differences.
Branch totals include historical objects; change counters describe loaded pairs only.
